brainlife.name: neuro/networkneuro

original.desc: Various .mat files generated from Network Neuro Application

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Visualising structural networks in the brainlife network viewer. Averaging density and count matrices across subjects.

**Not for:** Apps expecting neuro/conmat; convert first.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 5 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.networkneuro.json

files.desc: Connectivity matrices (CSV and MAT) and intermediate results.
Per ROI-pair data used by the network viewer.
VTK surfaces of the network nodes for visualisation.

identifying_risks: Individual connectomes can re-identify a person across datasets (connectome fingerprinting)
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level derivative; step 7 moves fingerprint use to Tier 4.
sharing_cautions: Share with participant codes only, inside a controlled project
tier_conditions: Tier 4 when used or released as connectome fingerprints or to predict traits or behaviour
Tier 1 when averaged across enough participants that no individual can be singled out
